title: Rebuild the marketing_sync CSV payload with opt-out and soft-delete privacy exclusions
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with build_payload(contacts) -> str producing the marketing_sync CSV: fixed header CONT_ID,EMAIL_TX,FRST_NM,LAST_NM,PREF_CH; one row per includable contact in input order; contacts with OPTOUT_FLG='Y' or DEL_FLG='Y' contribute nothing; blank PREF_CH written as E; RFC-4180-style quoting (quote fields containing comma/quote/CR/LF, double embedded quotes); rows joined with \n and a trailing newline.
expected_behavior: Payload for a plain contact matches character-for-character; no field of an opted-out or soft-deleted contact (id, email, or name) appears anywhere in the output; blank OPTOUT_FLG means included (blank=N); commas and quotes are quoted per RFC 4180; empty input yields just the header line.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, §6).
security_expectations: Privacy preservation: opted-out (OPTOUT_FLG='Y') and soft-deleted contacts must NEVER appear in the marketing payload in any form (no id, email, or name leakage); no network or I/O in the deliverable.
failure_conditions: Any opted-out or soft-deleted contact data in the payload; treating blank OPTOUT_FLG as opted out; wrong header; unquoted commas/quotes; reordering contacts; missing or doubled trailing newline.
